import cv2,numpy as np
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter1d
from scipy.signal import find_peaks,peak_widths
im=cv2.imread('terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448_rotated_cw0p5_clean_upper_right_724x724_arrow_removed_opencv_base.png',0)
for name,(x0,y0,x1,y1) in [('A',(65,220,420,540)),('B',(65,350,400,660)),('C',(170,330,465,610)),('D',(40,200,380,650))]:
 gray=im[y0:y1,x0:x1].astype(float)
 y,x=np.indices(gray.shape,dtype=float);y+=y0;x+=x0
 opts=[]
 for theta in np.arange(141.2,143.01,0.1):
  t=np.deg2rad(theta);v=(-np.sin(t)*x+np.cos(t)*y); idx=np.floor(v).astype(int);idx-=idx.min();n=int(idx.max()+1)
  cnt=np.bincount(idx.ravel(),minlength=n)
  mean=np.bincount(idx.ravel(),weights=(255-gray).ravel(),minlength=n)/np.maximum(cnt,1)
  prof=gaussian_filter1d(mean,.6);resid=prof-gaussian_filter1d(prof,13)
  valid=cnt>=120
  score=float(np.std(resid[valid])) if valid.any() else -1
  opts.append((score,theta,resid,valid))
 score,theta,resid,valid=max(opts,key=lambda z:z[0])
 res=np.where(valid,resid,-1000)
 pk,pr=find_peaks(res,prominence=5,distance=16)
 pk=pk[(pk>8)&(pk<len(res)-8)]
 widths=peak_widths(res,pk,rel_height=.5)[0]
 centers=[]
 for p in pk:
  f0,f1,f2=res[p-1],res[p],res[p+1];den=f0-2*f1+f2
  shift=float(np.clip(.5*(f0-f2)/den if abs(den)>1e-9 else 0,-.5,.5))
  centers.append(float(p+shift))
 gaps=np.diff(centers)
 good=gaps[(gaps>19)&(gaps<26)]
 good_widths=widths[(widths>=1.2)&(widths<=7)]
 print('BEST',name,round(float(theta),3),'SCORE',round(score,2),'PEAKS',len(pk),'GAP_COUNT',len(good),'GAP_MEDIAN',round(float(np.median(good)),3),'GAP_MEAN',round(float(np.mean(good)),3),'WIDTH_MEDIAN',round(float(np.median(good_widths)),3),'WIDTH_N',len(good_widths),'GAPS',np.round(good,2).tolist(),flush=True)
